description:
Welcome to this stunning 3-bedroom home featuring a sparkling pool, breathtaking city views, and unforgettable sunsets. Designed for both comfort and entertaining, this home is perfectly timed for summer living.

The open-concept floor plan offers a spacious living area that flows seamlessly into a beautifully updated kitchen, complete with granite countertops and top-of-the-line appliances—ideal for hosting family and friends.

Upstairs, retreat to the expansive primary suite, accompanied by two generously sized bedrooms. The bathrooms have been tastefully updated, adding a refined touch throughout.

Step outside to your private backyard oasis, where you can relax by the pool, entertain guests, or simply unwind while taking in the stunning sunset views. Located in a wonderful neighborhood, this home offers the perfect blend of tranquility and lifestyle.

This is a home you won’t want to miss.
